published_implementation.historical_relation: The benchmark publisher executes released third-party coding harness CLIs against a local scripted mock through harness-specific provider/protocol adapters and isolated configuration directories. These are real harness processes under a benchmark scaffold, not model-backed task-quality runs.

result.model_surface: local scripted llm-mock; no real model inference

execution.workload: 100 scripted tool-use turns with approximately 4 KB response content per turn; pi uses a harness-specific generated script long enough to exercise 100 tool rounds
execution.mock: local scripted mock endpoint with harness-matched protocol and tool schema; no model inference, network latency, GPU, or external service resources included
execution.machine: macOS; Apple Silicon; 18 cores; source reports batch load average 2.9-3.8
execution.aggregation: median end-to-end run selected from three serial runs
execution.reset_policy: each harness runs in its own isolated playground/configuration sandbox; batch runs were serial
